rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an official or informational document.

example.english: You need to submit this document to the company before you can register.
example.traditional: 呢份文件要交畀公司先可以報名。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 man6 gin6 jiu3 gaau1 bei2 gung1 si1 sin1 ho2 ji5 bou3 meng4

rows.note: Use this when the document is specifically submitted as proof or supporting evidence.

example.english: You need to bring this supporting document as proof before you can apply.
example.traditional: 你要帶埋呢份證明文件先可以申請。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 daai3 maai4 ni1 fan6 zing3 ming4 man6 gin6 sin1 ho2 ji5 san1 cing2

rows.note: Use this in formal or legal contexts for an official written instrument or document.

example.english: The agreement only officially takes effect after both parties sign the document.
example.traditional: 雙方簽署文書後，協議先正式生效。
example.jyutping: soeng1 fong1 cim1 cyu5 man4 syu1 hau6 hip3 ji5 sin1 zing3 sik1 sang1 haau6
